2024.stem: 【单项选择题】The following suggestions are given to managers EXCEPT _____.
2024.explanation: 文中给出了几条建议，包括调整项目日程安排、建立多团队系统以及明确任务优先级。但是没有提 到改善工作条件。故B项正确。A项有提及，第四段提到“managers should carefully map out the project tasks and timetable”。C项有提及，第五段提到“converting your team of nine into three teams…”。D项有提及，最后一段提到“Understanding the connections between different tasks is especially crucial for setting priorities to avoid bottlenecks.” 【全文翻译】 过去两年表明，员工渴望更多的灵活性，并且他们愿意为了获得这种灵活性而换工作。灵活性对员工有 着巨大的好处，包括减少倦怠感和提高工作满意度。然而，这也可能导致管理层的协调成本上升、浪费大量 努力以及无法迅速响应客户需求。曾经让团队迅速集思广益、协调努力的简短会议现在更难召集了。让大多 数成员同时出现在同一个虚拟场所可能需要几天的时间（包括一个人在牙医椅子上半听半不听地参与）。 为了增加团队中员工的灵活性，经理们需要指导和支持。否则，他们可能会对工作感到沮丧或离职去寻 找新工作。以下是一些方法，经理们可以在不增加协调成本或显著阻碍进度的情况下，为团队提供灵活性。 首先，重新考虑员工一起工作的时间。对于需要团队合作的复杂任务，为员工提供完全的灵活性（即随 时随地工作任何时长）并不可行。然而，恢复到标准的办公室工作周也不可行。因此，经理们需要不同且深 入地思考项目要求，并据此安排时间。 对于基于项目的工作流程，经理们应仔细规划项目任务和时间表，并提前要求员工在关键项目阶段（如 启动、中期、定稿）预留一组重叠工作日。对于不可预测性更高的工作流程，应将工作时间段与日历时间相 匹配。例如，在每月的第二周，员工需要在上午10点至下午5点工作，然后在该月剩余时间里，他们可以选择 每周工作40小时（±10小时）。 其次，重新考虑谁一起工作。为了提供更大的灵活性，经理们可能需要将较大的团队重新组织成多个由 较小、授权且相互关联的小组组成的多团队系统。例如，将9人团队拆分为3个3人小组，使他们能够做出决策 ，并更容易地协调彼此的工作。 此外，经理们还必须比以往任何时候都更深入地思考员工任务和优先事项的结构。了解不同任务之间的 联系对于设定优先事项、避免瓶颈尤为重要。如果所有事情都是优先事项，那么就没有什么是优先事项了。 【题干】Passage Four Conversation goes far beyond talking.It also involves eyes, smiles, and the silences between the words.When those elements hum along together, conversational partners feel most deeply engaged and connected. Like good conversationalists, Dartmouth College scientists have taken that idea and carried it to new places.They report some surprising findings on the interplay between eye contact and how two people synchronize (同步) nerve activity while talking.The researchers suggest, in a paper published in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences USA, that being in tune with a conversational partner is good—but that occasionally falling out of sync might be even better. Maintaining eye contact has long been thought to act as the glue that connects two people in conversation.Its absence can signal failure of social function.Similarly, the growing study along this line has largely focused on the way synchrony in individuals’ brain activity benefits the social connection between them. Earlier research by the Dartmouth lab had showed that synchronized pupil expansion serves as a reliable indicator of shared attention, which in turn marks greater nerve synchrony.In the new study, which measured pupil expansion during unstructured 10-minute conversations, the researchers found that the initial moment of eye contact—rather than a sustained period of locked gazes—marks a peak in shared attention.Synchrony, in fact, drops sharply just after you look into your conversation partner’s eyes and begins to recover only when you and that person look away from each other.“Eye contact is not eliciting synchrony; it’s disrupting it,” says Thalia Wheatley, the paper’s senior author. Why would this happen? Wheatley contends that making and breaking eye contact ultimately propels the conversation forward.“Perhaps what this is doing is allowing us to break synchrony and move back into our own heads so that we can bring forth new and individual contributions to keep the conversation going,” Wheatley says. Connections between gaze and synchrony might be relevant to research in autism (自闭症) and other mental disorders that involve non-typical interaction.The findings also help explain frustrations over videoconferencing platforms, on which real eye contact is nearly impossible to make—or break—because of the positioning of cameras and windows on screens.

2024.explanation: 最后一段提到，“Connections between gaze and synchrony might be relevant to research in autism (自闭症) and other mental disorders that involve non-typical interaction.”由此可知 Wheatley的研究结果暗示了对自闭症和其他涉及非典型互动的精神障碍的研究可能有所帮助，从而有助于了 解交流障碍。故B项正确。A、C项没有提及；D项，虽然提到了视频会议平台的问题，但并不是研究结果的主 要含义。 【全文翻译】 对话远远超出了说话的范畴。它还涉及眼神交流、微笑以及言语之间的沉默。当这些元素和谐共存时 ，对话的双方会感受到最深刻的参与感和联系感。 就像优秀的对话者一样，达特茅斯学院的科学家们也采纳了这一理念，并将其带到了新的领域。他们在 《美国国家科学院院刊》上发表的一篇论文中报告了一些令人惊讶的发现，这些发现涉及眼神交流与两人在 交谈时神经活动同步性之间的相互作用。研究人员认为，与对话伙伴保持协调固然很好，但偶尔的不同步可 能更好。 长期以来，人们一直认为保持眼神交流是连接对话双方的粘合剂。眼神交流的缺失可能意味着社交功能 的失败。同样，沿着这一方向的研究大多集中在个体大脑活动同步性如何促进他们之间的社交联系上。 达特茅斯实验室的早期研究表明，同步的瞳孔扩张是共同注意力的可靠指标，而共同注意力又标志着更 高的神经同步性。在新的研究中，研究人员测量了10分钟非结构性对话期间的瞳孔扩张情况，他们发现，最 初的眼神交流瞬间——而不是持续锁定目光的时期——标志着共同注意力的高峰。事实上，在你与对话伙伴 眼神交流之后，同步性会急剧下降，只有当你和对方移开视线时，同步性才开始恢复。“眼神交流并没有引 发同步性，而是在破坏它，”该论文的主要作者塔莉娅·惠特利说。 为什么会发生这种情况呢？惠特利认为，建立和打破眼神交流最终会推动对话的进展。“也许这样做可 以让我们打破同步性，回到我们自己的思维中，从而提出新的、个性化的观点，让对话继续下去，”惠特利 说。 眼神交流与同步性之间的联系可能与自闭症和其他涉及非典型互动的精神障碍的研究有关。这些发现还 有助于解释视频会议平台上的挫败感，因为摄像头和屏幕窗口的位置使得真正的眼神交流几乎不可能建立或 打破。 【题干】Section B Directions: In this section,you are required to read one quoted blog and the comments on it.The blog and comments are followed by questions or unfinished statements, each with four suggested answers A,B, C and D.Choose the best answer and mark your answer on the Answer Sheet. Talking about worry, I think of the most anxiety-provoking time of my life.It was 2008, and I was pregnant with my first child.At my ultrasound checkup, my husband and I learned that our son would be born with a congenital (先天的) heart condition.This condition is fatal if not corrected through open-heart surgery within months of birth.For the remainder of my pregnancy, I was almost never completely free of worry: How can we get him the best care? How will this affect his life? Doesn’t this mean that I should prevent worry as soon as possible? Yet, that is exactly the wrong thing to do.Suppressing thoughts and feelings never works—and paradoxically increases anxiety while reinforcing the belief that worries are uncontrollable. I discovered this for myself with my son’s heart condition.My worries were constant and exhausting, but putting them aside didn’t work.So I tried the opposite.I used my worries.Every time I worried, I went into action mode: I read every paper published on the condition, I asked our nurses and doctors a million questions, and I imagined best- and worst-case scenarios so I could plan each detail of my son’s care.Gradually I learn to worry smart and eventually worry less. Our son is now 14 years old.He loves playing the piano, writing, and wrestling.As his doctors told us after his surgery, there are no restrictions on what he can do. 2024.passage: Conversation goes far beyond talking.It also involves eyes, smiles, and the silences between the words.When those elements hum along together, conversational partners feel most deeply engaged and connected. Like good conversationalists, Dartmouth College scientists have taken that idea and carried it to new places.They report some surprising findings on the interplay between eye contact and how two people synchronize (同步) nerve activity while talking.The researchers suggest, in a paper published in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences USA, that being in tune with a conversational partner is good—but that occasionally falling out of sync might be even better. Maintaining eye contact has long been thought to act as the glue that connects two people in conversation.Its absence can signal failure of social function.Similarly, the growing study along this line has largely focused on the way synchrony in individuals’ brain activity benefits the social connection between them. Earlier research by the Dartmouth lab had showed that synchronized pupil expansion serves as a reliable indicator of shared attention, which in turn marks greater nerve synchrony.In the new study, which measured pupil expansion during unstructured 10-minute conversations, the researchers found that the initial moment of eye contact—rather than a sustained period of locked gazes—marks a peak in shared attention.Synchrony, in fact, drops sharply just after you look into your conversation partner’s eyes and begins to recover only when you and that person look away from each other.“Eye contact is not eliciting synchrony; it’s disrupting it,” says Thalia Wheatley, the paper’s senior author. Why would this happen? Wheatley contends that making and breaking eye contact ultimately propels the conversation forward.“Perhaps what this is doing is allowing us to break synchrony and move back into our own heads so that we can bring forth new and individual contributions to keep the conversation going,” Wheatley says. Connections between gaze and synchrony might be relevant to research in autism (自闭症) and other mental disorders that involve non-typical interaction.The findings also help explain frustrations over videoconferencing platforms, on which real eye contact is nearly impossible to make—or break—because of the positioning of cameras and windows on screens.

2025.stem: The candidate’s <u>blunder</u> during the debate cost him the election.
2025.explanation: 这道题目考察的是词汇在语境中的应用。我们需要根据句子的意思来判断哪个词最合适。句子说的 是：“候选人在辩论中的失误让他输掉了选举。”A. strategy - 策略。这个词不符合句子的语境，因为策 略本身不会导致输掉选举。B. behavior - 行为。虽然行为可能会影响选举结果，但这里强调的是具体的错 误。C. mistake - 错误。这个词最符合句子的语境，因为“失误”直接导致了输掉选举。D. concession - 让步。这个词也不符合句子的语境，因为让步不一定会导致输掉选举。综上所述，最合适的词是 “mistake”，因为它直接对应了句子中的“失误”。所以，正确答案是C选项：“mistake”。

2025.stem: Only when you’ve got enough credits will you be <u>eligible</u> to apply for the degree.
2025.explanation: 答案：C这道题目考察的是词汇在特定语境下的应用。首先，我们分析句子结构和意思：“只有当你 获得足够的学分，你才有资格申请这个学位。”这里的关键是理解“有资格”这个词组，在英语中常用“be qualified to do sth.”来表达。现在，我们逐一审视选项：A. liable - 这个词通常用于表示“有责任的 ”或“应受责备的”，与句意不符。B. available - 意为“可用的”或“可得到的”，同样不符合句意。C. qualified - 正如前面分析的，“be qualified to do sth.”表示“有资格做某事”，与句子意思吻合。D. prepared - 意为“准备好的”，虽然与学习和申请学位的过程相关，但不符合“有资格”这一具体意思。综 上所述，根据句子的语境和意思，最合适的选项是C，“qualified”。这个词准确地表达了“只有获得足够 学分的人才有资格申请学位”的意思。

2025.stem: Directions: Translate the following passage into Chinese.Write your answer on the Answer Sheet. When you’re enjoying the outdoors—whether you’re at a local park or camping in the wilderness—it’s important to minimize your impact on the environment around you.Anything you leave behind, even by accident, could be harmful to animals or plants.To reduce your impact on nature, practice the principles of “leave no trace”.That means leaving an area exactly as you found it when you arrived.Always look around to make sure you picked up everything you brought with you.It’s also best not to take items you find in nature.Rocks, shells, and sticks are part of the local ecosystem and should be left alone.
2025.answer: 【参考译文】当你在户外活动时，无论是在本地公园游玩，还是在野外露营，尽量减少对周围环 境的影响至关重要。你留下的任何物品，即便是无心之举，都可能对动植物造成伤害。为降低对自然的影响 ，请践行“无痕原则”：即离开时让环境保持与初到时完全一致的状态。务必环顾四周，确保带走所有随身 物品。同样重要的是，不要带走自然环境中发现的物品。岩石、贝壳和树枝都是当地生态系统的组成部分 ，应当保持原状。
2025.explanation: 1. 句式处理上，原文 “when you’re enjoying...whether you’re...or...” 复合句，翻译时 将 “whether” 引导的从句拆为 “无论是在本地公园游玩，还是在野外露营”，契合中文 “无论 A 还是 B” 的表达习惯，避免英文长句直译的生硬感；2. 核心语义传递上，“minimize your impact” 译为 “尽 量减少影响”，精准体现 “最小化” 的含义，“leave no trace” 作为户外固定术语译为 “无痕原则 ”，兼顾专业性与易懂性，“exactly as you found it” 补充 “状态” 二字译为 “与初到时完全一致的 状态”，让语义更完整；3. 细节表达优化上，“even by accident” 转化为 “即便是无心之举”，将副词 短语变为中文常用主谓结构，更自然，“should be left alone” 不直译 “被单独留下”，而是译为 “应 当保持原状”，准确传达 “不触碰、不带走” 的核心；4. 逻辑衔接上，用冒号连接 “无痕原则” 与后文 解释，让定义更清晰，“it’s also best not to...” 译为 “同样重要的是，不要...”，通过 “同样重 要” 强化建议的递进关系，符合中文逻辑节奏。

2025.stem: Directions: Write a composition in no less than 150 words on the topic: The Importance of Lifelong Learning.You could write according to the hints given below.Write your composition on the Answer Sheet. In the rapidly changing world today, the value of lifelong learning has become increasingly evident.Discuss the significance of lifelong learning in individuals’ personal and professional development.Include examples and reasons to support your viewpoint.
2025.answer: 【参考范文】The Importance of Lifelong Learning (1) In today’s fast-changing world, lifelong learning has become essential for personal and professional growth.With technological advancements and evolving industries, individuals must continuously update their knowledge and skills to remain competitive. (2) Firstly, lifelong learning enhances career prospects.Many professions now require workers to adapt to new technologies and methodologies.For example, an IT professional must keep learning programming languages and tools to stay relevant.Similarly, doctors must stay updated on medical breakthroughs to provide the best care.Without continuous learning, one risks falling behind in their field. (3) Moreover, lifelong learning fosters personal development.It broadens perspectives, improves critical thinking, and keeps the mind active.For instance, learning a new language or skill can open doors to new cultures and opportunities.Additionally, studies show that engaging in intellectual activities reduces the risk of cognitive decline in old age. Comment 2: We’re always on our own schedule and have been able to experience each destination in a totally different way.If we end up really liking a specific spot, we can choose to stay longer if we want. Comment 3: The size of the van can make for constant re-organisation of things, and a lot of bumping elbows. Comment 4: If your van or boat breaks down and needs to be repaired or replaced, this can leave you in a tricky situation as it is your home.Ours took almost a month to fix, and we had to get it towed 200 miles.Since we had to stay with family out of town we weren’t able to work.

writing.source: Personality is the pattern of thoughts, feelings and behaviors unique to a person.People tend to think of personality as fixed.But according to psychologists, that’s not how it works.Personality is a developmental phenomenon.It’s not just a static thing that you’re stuck with and can’t get over.That’s not to say that you’re a different person each day you wake up.In the short term, change can be nearly impossible to be perceived.Long-term studies, in which researchers survey the personalities of participants regularly over many years, suggest that our personality is stable only on shorter time scales.
writing.reference: 性格是一个人独一无二的思维、情感和行为模式。人们通常认为性格是固定的，但是心理学家们认为并 非如此。一个人的性格是一种不断发展的现象。它不是一成不变、无法改变的。当然这并不是说，每天早上 醒来，你都是一个不同的人。短期来看，性格的改变几乎无法察觉。而在长期的研究中，当研究者长时间定 期观测调查研究对象的性格特征后，发现性格稳定这一观点只在短期维度上成立。
writing.notes: （1）.第二、三句都为短句，正好表达是两个相反的观点，翻译的时候可以合并为一个句子。 （2）.第四句为it形式主语，其中，static意为“静态的”。be stuck with意为“遇到困难无法进行下去 ”，而get over意为“克服（困难）”，在这句话中这两个短语要表达的意思就是人的性格并不是无法改变 的。 （3）.最后一句中，in which引导非限制性定语从句，修饰主语long-term studies，翻译的时候按照原文语 序翻译即可。

writing.topic: What are the benefits and disadvantages of online learning?
writing.source: As the coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic seems to be here to stay, we perhaps have to choose online instruction sometimes.The mode of instruction and learning may have its advantages, but ...
writing.reference: What are the benefits and disadvantages of online learning? (1) As the coronavirus pandemic seems to be here to stay, we perhaps have to choose online instruction sometimes.It is true that students benefit a lot from the online learning.However, every coin has two sides. (2) On the one hand, online learning is convenient for students to study at home, especially under the special circumstances of COVID-19 pandemic in 2019.In addition, students are allowed to download the class video so that they can study in their own pace and review it at any time.On the other hand, online learning will also restrain students’ learning space and possibility.Without communicating face by face, students cannot exchange their points instantly.Otherwise, it is not convenient for teachers to supervise students’ learning status, which means that some students may easily wander off in class. (3) To sum up, students should make best use of the Internet to get the information they need and resist the temptation of being away from teachers’ monitor.

writing.source: Our lives would be remarkably limited without language.Our social interactions rely very heavily on language.We are considerably more knowledgeable than people of previous generations because knowledge passed on from one generation to the next via language. What is language? According to Harley, it is a system of symbols and rules that enable us to communicate.Symbols are things that stand for other things: Words, either written or spoken, are symbols.The rules specify how words are ordered to form sentences.Communication is the primary function of language.We can use language for thinking, to record information, to express emotion, and so on.
writing.reference: 没有语言，我们的生活将受到极大的限制。我们的社交非常依赖语言。我们比前几代人知识渊博，因为 知识能通过语言代代相传的。 语言是什么？哈利认为语言是一套符号和规则的系统，使我们更好地交流。符号能代表其他事物：书面 或口头词汇都是符号。语言规则规定了单词如何排列成句子。交际是语言的主要功能。我们可以通过语言来 思考，记录信息，表达情感等。
writing.notes: （1）.第一段第一句中，翻译时把without后的内容提到前面，更加符合中文表达的语序。 （2）.第二段第四句为how引导的宾语从句，specify表示“规定”，宾语从句用于解释“规定”的主要内容 。

writing.topic: Why machine translation can/can not fully replace human translators? You should write according to the hints given below
writing.source: Directions: Write an essay in no less than 150 words on the topic: Why machine translation can/can not fully replace human translators? You should write according to the hints given below.Write your essay on the answer sheet. Machines are replacing in different areas of the work force.The technology of machine translation is also getting better with time.What is your opinion about this issue? Think of the issue in terms of speed, accuracy and performance.
writing.reference: Why machine translation can not fully replace human translators? (1) With the progress of artificial intelligence, the competition between machine translation and human translators arouses great interest among the public.Some people are in flavor of machine translation, while others hold a positive attitude towards human translators.After a thorough consideration, I believe that machine translation can’t replace human translators. (2) Machine translation is regarded as a double-edged sword.Though, compared with human translators, machine translation is more convenient and less time-consuming, the content translated by human is more flexible and accurate.In most cases in real life, human translators need to check and revise the translation of machine.In addition, sometimes the translation of machine is very rigid so that readers may feel difficult to understand.Instead, human can polish the language of their translation according to specific contexts or situations. (3) From what has been discussed before, we can draw the conclusion that machine translation cannot fully replace human translators.

writing.source: Creative thinking may feel like a superpower reserved only for a creative person.Thankfully, creative geniuses aren’t the only ones who can have innovative ideas.At its core, creative thinking is intentionally gaining new insights and different ideas through existing information.Often, creative thought involves tapping into different styles of thinking and examining information from different viewpoints to see new patterns.Anyone can develop a creative mind with some practice.Using a wide variety of brainstorming strategies can help you discover new solutions for issues in every area of your life.Learning different styles of thinking can help give birth to powerful idea generation.
writing.reference: 创造性思维可能会让人感觉像是“创造性人才”才拥有的超能力。值得庆幸的是，并不是只有创新天才 才拥有创新的想法。创造性思维的核心是有意地通过现有的信息获取新的见解和不同的想法。通常，创造性 思维包括利用不同的思维方式，并从不同的角度审视信息，以发现新的模式。任何人都可以通过练习来培养 创造性思维。使用各种各样的头脑风暴策略可以帮助你发现生活各个领域问题的新的解决方案。学习不同的 思维方式有助于产生强大的想法。
writing.notes: 1.第二句中who引导定语从句，修饰先行词the only ones，在翻译这句时，注意不要直译，可以进 行调整，将从句融入到主句中，更符合中文表达习惯。 2.第四句略长，翻译的时候可以恰当进行切分，本句的谓语动词是involve，后面的tapping和examining为 动名词作宾语，顺译即可。tap into意为“挖掘；利用；开发”。 3.倒数第二句，动名词using作主语，可按照原文语序翻译。 4.give birth to产生，造成。

writing.topic: The Advantages and Disadvantages of the Self-employed Jobs
writing.source: 1.Nowadays, with the development of the Internet and society, more and more people choose to be self-employed. 2.Your view on self-employed jobs is ...
writing.reference: The Advantages and Disadvantages of the Self-employed Jobs (1) Nowadays, with the development of the Internet and society, more and more people choose to be self-employed.The growing working pressure also gives rise to this phoneme.From my perspectives, people should think about it seriousy, for every coin has two sides. (2) On the one hand, self-employment have some advantages.People can decide their own working time and places according to their own life styles and habits, which will help increase working efficiency in turn.Also, people’s intelligence will be fully developed, and they will be more concentrated on the jobs if the profits are all earned for themselves.However, on the other hand, self-employment is still a high-risk working style, for there is no guarantee that they will earn enough to live comfortably.In addition, work can be quite difficult without sharing the workload by others. (3) In conclusion, one should make adequate preparations before making the decision.What matters most is to find the proper way.
writing.notes: 【参考范文】 The Advantages and Disadvantages of the Self-employed Jobs (1) Nowadays, with the development of the Internet and society, more and more people choose to be self-employed.The growing working pressure also gives rise to this phoneme.From my perspectives, people should think about it seriousy, for every coin has two sides. (2) On the one hand, self-employment have some advantages.People can decide their own working time and places according to their own life styles and habits, which will help increase working efficiency in turn.Also, people’s intelligence will be fully developed, and they will be more concentrated on the jobs if the profits are all earned for themselves.However, on the other hand, self-employment is still a high-risk working style, for there is no guarantee that they will earn enough to live comfortably.In addition, work can be quite difficult without sharing the workload by others. (3) In conclusion, one should make adequate preparations before making the decision.What matters most is to find the proper way. 【审题构思】 本题要求围绕“自主创业的利弊”这一标题，写一篇不少于150词的文章。写作时，可以在首段引入主题 ，说明现状。第二段分点阐述自主创业的利与弊。第三段简单概括全文，强调自己的观点即可。 【行文点评】 （1）文章首段指出现象，随着科技的发展，以及工作压力增大，许多人选择自主创业。自主创业有利有 弊。 （2）文章第二段主要论述了自主创业的利和弊。一方面，自主创业可以自由选择工作时间和场所，可以 充分发挥自己的才智，也会全身心投入挣钱。另一方面，自主创业风险很高，而且没有同伴分担工作负担。 （3）最后总结全文，再次表明观点，根据自身情况做出合适的选择。 【题干】Section A Directions: In this section there are two incomplete dialogues and each dialogue has three blanks and three choices A, B and C, taken from the dialogue.Fill in each of the blanks with one of the choices to complete the dialogue and mark your answer on the ANSWER SHEET. Dialogue One A.Did you wash your teeth after eating chocolate last night? B.What’s the matter? C.I will remember from this time on. Jim: Mom, I don’t feel well.Could you call the teacher and ask for leave for me? Mom: (1) _____ Jim: My teeth ache.It’s painful! Mom: (2) _____ Jim: Emm...No. Mom: Well, everything happens for a reason.It pays back now.You have to learn a good lesson this time.How many times I have told you the importance of oral hygiene. Jim: Mom, (3) _____ I swear! Mom: Hope so.I will call the teacher, but this is the last time, OK? Get up and wash your teeth right now, and it can relieve your pain.If you still feel painful at noon, remember to call me and I will take you to your dentist.

writing.source: While everyone’s image of their dream home looks a little different, most people will agree that their ideal neighborhood is filled with friendly faces and neighbors they can rely on in a time of need.However, as is the case with all friendships, getting to know your neighbors takes time and effort— though potentially less than you may expect.There are real benefits to getting to know your neighbors.A recent study found that people with positive social perceptions of their neighborhoods were less likely to experience depression, anxiety and loneliness.
writing.reference: 虽然每个人在想象自己心目中的家园时都有些许不同，但大多数人都会认同，他们理想的社区处处都是 友善的街坊邻里，这些人可以在需要的时候给予帮扶。然而，就像所有的友情一样，要了解你的邻居是需要 付出时间和精力的——尽管这些付出可能没你预期的那么多。结识邻里会给你带来诸多实实在在的好处。最 近的一项研究发现，那些对自己的社区抱有积极的社会认知的人很少会有抑郁、焦虑和孤独之感。
writing.notes: 1.第一句中，while引导让步状语从句，应该翻译为“虽然，尽管”的意思。Agree引导宾语从句 ，而从句中neighbors后又为定语从句，注意调整语序。be filled with为固定搭配，意为“充满……”。 2.第二句中，as引导定语从句，修饰整个句子，带有“正如”的含义。此句中为动名词作主语，按照正常语 序翻译即可。 3.最后一句中，that引导宾语从句。be likely to为固定搭配，意为“有可能”。

writing.topic: Is Winners the Most Important in Our Life?
writing.source: Our life is often filled with competitions of all forms and kinds.As a result, people are often judged as winners or losers in those competitions.Is winning the most important in our life? Give your opinion and reasons.
writing.reference: Is Winners the Most Important in Our Life? (1) Nowadays, the concept of winning has sparked heated debate.Some people attach great importance to being winners, believing that winning means gaining the acceptance from the society.However, from my perspective, it doesn’t matter whether you are a winner or a loser. (2) In fact, it is hard to define success or failure.People’s views over this question vary from person to person.In my opinion, what matters most is the process, during which we can promote ourselves to reach the standard of success, broaden our horizons, make acquaintance with new friends and even inspire our potential.Though we may fail finally, the process is a precious treasure for us all.Actually, being a winner in a competition can evaluate one’s ability and competence, but it cannot be recognized as the only standard.Other factors such as personality, experience and so on should be considered as well. (3) It is indisputable that winning plays an essential role in our life, but we should also learn from failure.
writing.notes: 【参考范文】 Is Winners the Most Important in Our Life? (1) Nowadays, the concept of winning has sparked heated debate.Some people attach great importance to being winners, believing that winning means gaining the acceptance from the society.However, from my perspective, it doesn’t matter whether you are a winner or a loser. (2) In fact, it is hard to define success or failure.People’s views over this question vary from person to person.In my opinion, what matters most is the process, during which we can promote ourselves to reach the standard of success, broaden our horizons, make acquaintance with new friends and even inspire our potential.Though we may fail finally, the process is a precious treasure for us all.Actually, being a winner in a competition can evaluate one’s ability and competence, but it cannot be recognized as the only standard.Other factors such as personality, experience and so on should be considered as well. (3) It is indisputable that winning plays an essential role in our life, but we should also learn from failure. 【审题构思】 本题要求围绕“如何在现代生活中过上简单的生活”这一标题，写一篇不少于150词的文章。写作时，可 以在首段引入主题，说明现状。第二段列举几个从简生活的例子并说明理由。第三段简单概括全文，强调自 己的观点即可。 【行文点评】 （1）文章首段指出现象，说明许多人重视成功。接着引出个人观点，是否成为胜者并不重要。 （2）文章第二段阐述理由，主要从两方面入手：首先，关于成功和失败的定义因人而异，重要的不是结 果，而是努力的过程；其次，成功不能被视为衡量一个人的唯一标准，还需要考虑其他因素。 （3）最后总结全文，再次表明观点，虽然成功很重要，但是也要从失败中学习。 【题干】Section A Directions: In this section there are two incomplete dialogues and each dialogue has three blanks and three choices A, B and C, taken from the dialogue.Fill in each of the blanks with one of the choices to complete the dialogue and mark your answer on the ANSWER SHEET. Dialogue One A.When was this purchase made? B.What’s wrong with it? C.Can you tell me what the charge was? Alice: I have a problem with my credit card. Bokkor: (1) _____ Alice: There is a charge on my card that I didn’t make. Bokkor: (2) _____ Alice: It’s for a purse that cost $ 350. Bokkor: Are you sure that you didn’t buy the purse? Alice: I can’t even afford a purse that expensive. Bokkor: I’m very sorry.(3) _____ Alice: At 15: 15 on November 12th, I was at work then. Bokkor: We’re going to investigate this claim.

writing.source: Robots often have trouble picking up objects—they need to be trained on exactly where to reach and how to grasp.One problem is that they can’t touch.They can’t judge how firmly or softly to hold something.Now engineers have made a tool called TacTip.It’s a 3D-printed robotic fingertip with a rubbery outer “skin”.Below the skin are tiny, stiff pins.When TacTip touches something, a camera inside watches those pins getting pushed around.The researchers also added a microphone inside the fingertip, which helps judge vibrations.With all this information, the tool was pretty good at touching different fabrics and telling them apart.
writing.reference: 机器人在抓取物体时常遇挑战——它们必须接受精确的训练，以确定伸手的位置和抓握的方式。然而 ，一个显著的问题是它们缺乏触觉，无法感知应以何种力度轻柔或稳固地握住物体。为此，工程师们设计了 一种名为TacTip的创新工具。这款工具以3D打印技术制成，其人造指尖外层覆盖着橡胶材质的“皮肤”，而 在这层皮肤之下，则密布着微小的坚硬针头。当TacTip触碰物体时，内置的摄像头会密切监测这些针头的位 移情况。此外，研究团队还在指尖内置了一个麦克风，用以辅助分析振动信息。凭借这些综合信息 ，TacTip在触摸并区分不同织物方面展现出了相当出色的能力。
writing.notes: 1.第一句中，“where to reach and how to grasp”没有直译为“向哪里伸手以及如何抓握”，而 是译为“确定伸手的位置和抓握的方式”，这样的表述更加自然，不显生硬。 2.第二句中，“… they can’t touch.”译为“它们缺乏触觉”，这样更能体现问题的本质，即机器人没 有像人类那样的触觉感知能力。 3.翻译“When TacTip touches something, a camera inside watches those pins getting pushed around.”时，“a camera inside”译为“内置摄像头”。“push around”意为“摆布，驱使，把……推来 推去”，此处译为“位移情况”，传达了原文的技术性信息。

writing.topic: Why so many people pursue graduate studies?
writing.source: It is reported that a record number of more than 4.5 million people sat for the national exam for postgraduate enrollment in 2022, a 21.2% increase over the year before.Why do so many people choose to pursue graduate studies? Give your comments.
writing.reference: Why so many people pursue graduate studies? (1) The surge in graduate studies applicants, topping 4.5 million in 2022, highlights a strong trend: heightened demand for higher education.Key factors explain this growth. (2) Firstly, the drive for intellectual expansion amidst technological leaps and globalization propels many to pursue graduate degrees.These programs cultivate critical thinking, research skills, and specialized knowledge, crucial for professional excellence. (3) Secondly, career enhancement is a major incentive.Graduate degrees enhance job market competitiveness, leading to better job opportunities and salaries.They demonstrate a commitment to lifelong learning, boosting employability. (4) Additionally, personal fulfillment and self-actualization motivate many.Graduate studies offer a chance for self-discovery and pursuing passions, enriching lives and contributing to society. (5) Lastly, societal pressures and the premium placed on higher education by families and society contribute.Graduate degrees are seen as markers of success, fueling aspirations. (6) In summary, the growth in graduate applicants stems from intellectual curiosity, career goals, personal fulfillment, and societal pressures.This trend underscores the enduring significance of advanced education in shaping lives and advancing society.

(3) Secondly, career enhancement is a major incentive.Graduate degrees enhance job market competitiveness, leading to better job opportunities and salaries.They demonstrate a commitment to lifelong learning, boosting employability. (4) Additionally, personal fulfillment and self-actualization motivate many.Graduate studies offer a chance for self-discovery and pursuing passions, enriching lives and contributing to society. (5) Lastly, societal pressures and the premium placed on higher education by families and society contribute.Graduate degrees are seen as markers of success, fueling aspirations. (6) In summary, the growth in graduate applicants stems from intellectual curiosity, career goals, personal fulfillment, and societal pressures.This trend underscores the enduring significance of advanced education in shaping lives and advancing society. 【行文点评】 （1）文章首段指出研究生申请人数激增，反映了高等教育需求的增强，并暗示了背后的多重因素。 （2）第二段阐述第一个原因，知识探索和智力成长的追求是驱动许多人攻读研究生的主要因素。 （3）第三段阐述第二个原因，增强的职业前景是攻读研究生学位的重要动机。 （4）第四段阐述第三个原因，个人成就感和自我实现的愿望也是许多人选择继续深造的原因。 （5）第五段阐述第四个原因，社会压力和家庭、社会对高等教育的日益重视也推动了研究生申请人数的 增加。 （6）最后一段总结全文，研究生申请人数的增加是多种因素共同作用的结果，包括求知欲、职业追求、 个人满足感以及社会期望。 【题干】Section A Directions: In this section there are two incomplete dialogues and each dialogue has three blanks and three choices A, B and C, taken from the dialogue.Fill in each of the blanks with one of the choices to complete the dialogue and mark your answer on the ANSWER SHEET. Dialogue One A.Thanks for being supportive. B.Wasn’t that today? C.I was really nervous about it. Nathan: Hey, Alicia? Alicia: Oh hey, I’m glad we had time to meet up. Nathan: Me too.So, how did your interview go? (1) _____ Alicia: Oh, yeah.I think it went well.I don’t know if I got the job yet, but they said they would call in a few days. Nathan： Well, I’m sure you did great.Good luck. Alicia： Thanks.I’m just happy that it’s over.(2) _____ Nathan: I can understand that.I get nervous before interviews, too. Alicia: (3) _____ Nathan: Sure, no problem.

writing.source: When you’re enjoying the outdoors—whether you’re at a local park or camping in the wilderness—it’s important to minimize your impact on the environment around you.Anything you leave behind, even by accident, could be harmful to animals or plants.To reduce your impact on nature, practice the principles of “leave no trace”.That means leaving an area exactly as you found it when you arrived.Always look around to make sure you picked up everything you brought with you.It’s also best not to take items you find in nature.Rocks, shells, and sticks are part of the local ecosystem and should be left alone.
writing.reference: 当你在户外活动时，无论是在本地公园游玩，还是在野外露营，尽量减少对周围环 境的影响至关重要。你留下的任何物品，即便是无心之举，都可能对动植物造成伤害。为降低对自然的影响 ，请践行“无痕原则”：即离开时让环境保持与初到时完全一致的状态。务必环顾四周，确保带走所有随身 物品。同样重要的是，不要带走自然环境中发现的物品。岩石、贝壳和树枝都是当地生态系统的组成部分 ，应当保持原状。
writing.notes: 1. 句式处理上，原文 “when you’re enjoying...whether you’re...or...” 复合句，翻译时 将 “whether” 引导的从句拆为 “无论是在本地公园游玩，还是在野外露营”，契合中文 “无论 A 还是 B” 的表达习惯，避免英文长句直译的生硬感；2. 核心语义传递上，“minimize your impact” 译为 “尽 量减少影响”，精准体现 “最小化” 的含义，“leave no trace” 作为户外固定术语译为 “无痕原则 ”，兼顾专业性与易懂性，“exactly as you found it” 补充 “状态” 二字译为 “与初到时完全一致的 状态”，让语义更完整；3. 细节表达优化上，“even by accident” 转化为 “即便是无心之举”，将副词 短语变为中文常用主谓结构，更自然，“should be left alone” 不直译 “被单独留下”，而是译为 “应 当保持原状”，准确传达 “不触碰、不带走” 的核心；4. 逻辑衔接上，用冒号连接 “无痕原则” 与后文 解释，让定义更清晰，“it’s also best not to...” 译为 “同样重要的是，不要...”，通过 “同样重 要” 强化建议的递进关系，符合中文逻辑节奏。

writing.source: In the rapidly changing world today, the value of lifelong learning has become increasingly evident.Discuss the significance of lifelong learning in individuals’ personal and professional development.Include examples and reasons to support your viewpoint.
writing.reference: The Importance of Lifelong Learning (1) In today’s fast-changing world, lifelong learning has become essential for personal and professional growth.With technological advancements and evolving industries, individuals must continuously update their knowledge and skills to remain competitive. (2) Firstly, lifelong learning enhances career prospects.Many professions now require workers to adapt to new technologies and methodologies.For example, an IT professional must keep learning programming languages and tools to stay relevant.Similarly, doctors must stay updated on medical breakthroughs to provide the best care.Without continuous learning, one risks falling behind in their field. (3) Moreover, lifelong learning fosters personal development.It broadens perspectives, improves critical thinking, and keeps the mind active.For instance, learning a new language or skill can open doors to new cultures and opportunities.Additionally, studies show that engaging in intellectual activities reduces the risk of cognitive decline in old age. (4) In conclusion, lifelong learning is crucial in both professional success and personal fulfillment.By embracing continuous education, individuals can adapt to changes, achieve career growth, and lead more enriching lives.
writing.notes: 1. 结构逻辑上，范文采用 “总 - 分 - 总” 清晰框架，开篇结合 “快速变化的时代” 背景点明 终身学习对个人与职业发展的核心价值，奠定论点；中间两段分别从 “职业前景” 和 “个人发展” 展开 ，每段均用 “论点 + 具体例子” 论证（如 IT 从业者学新编程语言、医生跟进医学突破，以及学习新语言 拓宽视野），让观点更具说服力；结尾总结全文，重申终身学习对职业成功与个人满足感的意义，呼应开篇 形成逻辑闭环。2. 内容贴合度上，严格遵循题目要求，既覆盖了终身学习在职业（适应技术变化、避免行业 落后）和个人（拓宽视角、活跃思维、延缓认知衰退）两方面的意义，又通过贴近现实的例子支撑观点，满 足 “150 词以上”“含例子与理由” 的写作要求，无空泛论述。3. 语言表达上，用词精准贴合主题（如 “technological advancements”“medical breakthroughs”），句式兼顾简单句的流畅性与 “With...,” “Without...,” “studies show that...” 等结构的层次感，符合英文议论文的表达规范 。 【题干】Section A Directions: In this section there are two incomplete dialogues and each dialogue has three blanks and three choices A, B and C, taken from the dialogue.Fill in each of the blanks with one of the choices to complete the dialogue and mark your answer on the ANSWER SHEET. Dialogue One A.Let’s meet at the checkout. B.Yeah, that’s a great idea! C.And we also need some eggs and chocolate chips. Louise: Hey, Julia...Look at those desserts! How about baking some cookies today? Julia: (1) _____ While we’re here, let’s pick up the ingredients.But what do we need? Louise: The recipe calls for flour, sugar and butter.(2) _____ Julia: Why don’t you get the dairy ingredients? You’ll find those in the refrigerated section in the back of the store.I’ll get the dry ingredients—they’re in aisle 10. Louise: Great! (3) _____ Julia: OK.See you there.

grammar.title: 名词
grammar.body:
名词是表示人、事物、地点或抽象概念的词。
1.名词的语法功能
名词在句中主要作主语、宾语、表语、状语、定语、补语和同位语。
This book is very useful.（主语）
这本书非常有用。
He finished his task on time.（宾语）
他按时完成了任务。
My brother is a worker.（表语）
我弟弟是一名工人。
The meeting lasted two hours.（状语）
这场会议持续了两个小时。
His mother and father are both college teachers.（定语）
他的父母都是大学教师。
They made the girl director of the company.（补语）
他们任命这个女孩为公司的董事长。
We students should study hard.（同位语）
我们学生应该努力学习。
2.名词的数
规则可数名词单数变复数变化口诀：
名词单数变复数，直接加-s占多数;
s,x,ch,sh 来结尾,直接加上-es;
辅音+y在词尾,把y变i加-es;
词尾是f 或是fe,加-es 之前先变v;
词尾字母若是o,无生命的加-s。
3.名词所有格
名词所有格,表物是“谁的”;
若为生命词,加“s”即可行;
词尾有s,仅把撇号择;并列名词后,各自和共有;
前者分别加，后者最后加;
若为无命词，of 所有格;
前后须倒置,此是硬规则。

grammar.title: 冠词
grammar.body:
1.定冠词的用法
⑴特指双方都明白或上文提到过的人或物
Please mop the floor.
请把地板拖一下。
⑵指世界上独一无二的事物
the Great Wall 长城；the sun 太阳；the moon 月亮
⑶用在表示乐器的名词之前
She plays the piano.
她会弹钢琴。
⑷用在序数词前面
the third floor 三层；the first time 第一次
⑸与形容词或分词连用，表示一类人
the rich 富人；the un employed 失业者
⑹用在形容词 only，very，same 等前面
the same day 同一天；the only person 唯一一个人
⑺用在形容词最高级前面
the most interesting book 最有趣的书
⑻用在某些由普通名词构成的国家名称、机关团体、阶级等专有名词前
the People ’ s Republic of China中华人民共和国；the United States美国；
the Times《泰晤士报》；the Labor Party工党
⑼表示所有，相当于物主代词，用在表示身体部分的名词前
She touched him on the shoulder.她碰了碰他的肩膀。
⑽用在姓氏的复数名词之前，表示一家人
the Greens 格林一家人（或格林夫妇）
⑾用在某些固定词组中
at the same time 同时；for the time being 暂时
2.不定冠词的用法
不定冠词（a 或 an）相当于汉语中数目概念较弱的“一”。a 用于辅音音素前，an 用于
元音音素前。不定冠词的基本用法如下：
⑴用在可数名词单数前，泛指人或事物的类别
Achurch is a place of worship.
教堂是做礼拜的地方。
⑵用于第一次提到的，或对方不知道的人或物的名词前
Suddenly they heard a loud bang.
他们忽然听到砰的一声巨响。
⑶表示“每一”，相当于 every
They have music lessons twice a week.
他们一周上两次音乐课。
⑷表示“同一”，说明事物的同一性质、特征、大小或程度等
All the desks are of a size.
所有这些课桌的大小都是一样的。
⑸用于抽象名词前，使之具体化，表示与之相关的具体的或事
The party was quite a success.
这次聚会很成功。
⑹用于序数词前表示“又一，再一”，相当于 another
They propose d a third formula for the new swimming pool.
他们为新游泳池提出了第 3 种方案。
3.零冠词的用法
零冠词是指名词前面没有不定冠词（a，an）、定冠词（the）没有其他限定词的现象。
⑴用于不可数名词、物质名词和抽象名词前
Air plays a vital role.
空气是必不可少的。
⑵用于表示泛指的复数名词前
Doctors cure patients.
医生治病救人。
⑶用于表示“变成”的 turn/go 后作表语的单数名词前
He was a teacher before he turned writer.
他成为作家之前是教师。
⑷用于一日三餐学科名称、球类和棋类名词前
Do you like to play chess?
你喜欢下棋吗?
⑸用于年份、季节、月份、节日、假日、日期、星期等表示时间的名词前
If winter comes, can spring be far behind?
如果冬天来了，春天还会远吗?
⑹用于道路、广场、车站、机场、公园、桥梁等名称前
Nanjing Road 南京路；Hyde Park 海德公园

grammar.title: 介词
grammar.body:
常用介词辨析
⑴at ，in ，on
①at表示在某一时刻或较短的时间,或泛指节日、年龄。
at Christmas在圣诞节
②in表示在某世纪、朝代、时代、年、季节、月以及泛指的早、中、晚。
inMay在五月
③on表示在具体某一天、某一天的早、中、晚或节日的当天。
⑵in，after
①“in+时间段”表示将来的一段时间之后,多用于将来时,也可表示在过去的一段时间之
内，用于过去时。
in three weeks 三周内
②“after+ 时间段”表示过去的一段时间之后,多用于过去时。
after three hours 三个小时后
③“after+ 将来时间点”表示将来的某一时间点之后,多用于将来时。
after4o’clock 四点后
⑶at， in，on
①at表示位置、地点
at the corner of the street在这条街的拐角处
②in表示地点、场所，“在.....里面”,还可用来表示较大的空间或地点
in the d inning hall在餐厅
③on表示在物体表面之上。
on the table桌子上
⑷on，over，above
①on在……上面（物体表面有接触）
on the river在河上
②over 在……上方（垂直上方）
There is a lamp overt he table.
桌子正上方有一盏灯。
③above 在……上方（高过另一个物体，不强调垂直）其反义词为below
The moon is now above the trees.
月亮高挂在树的上方。
⑸like，as
①like表示“像……一样”。
Peter the Great,like his country,w as strong and proud.
彼得大帝像他的国家一样强健和自豪。
②as表示“作为，以……身份”。
He talked to me as a father.
他以父亲的身份跟我谈话。
⑹of， about,，on
①of仅是提到或谈到过某人或某事。
He s poke of the film the other day.
他前几天提到了这部影片。
②about指“关于”某人或某事物的较详细的情况。
Can you tell me something about yourself?
你能告诉我关于你自己的事情吗？
③on指“关于”学术性的或严肃的事。
It ’ s a textbook on the history of china.
它是一本有关中国历史的教科书。

grammar.title: 代词
grammar.body:
1.人称代词
人称代词代替人和事物的名称,分为主格和宾格两种形式。
⑴人称代词的主格在句中作主语
I ’ m a student.
我是一个学生。
⑵人称代词的宾格在句中作宾语或表语
It ’ s a present for me.
⑶在单独使用或带not的简略回答中用宾格不用主格
—I like swimming.
—Metoo.
⑷在感叹疑问句中做主语，以引起强调
—You can tell him.
你可以告诉他。
—Me tell him?Not likely!
我告诉他?不可能!
⑸在as或than后，若没带有动词时，多用宾格
I a mast all as him.
我和他一样高。
⑹人称代词单独使用时，要用宾格形式
—Who ha s bee n to New Y or k?谁去过纽约?
—Me.我。
⑺三个不同人称同时出现,或者主语中包含“我”时,按照“you→he→I”的顺序表达
Both he and I are working at that computer company.
我和他都在那家电脑公司上班。
⑻人称代词it除了可以指人指物之外,还可以表示“时间、天气、温度、距离、情况”等含
义,此外还可以作“非人称代词”使用,替代作主语或者宾语的不定式、动名词或者名词性
从句
It took him three days to clean his house.
打扫屋子花了他三天的时间。
2.物主代词
说明事物所属关系的代词,分为形容词性和名词性两种。
(1)形容词性物主代词的语法功能
①形容词性物主代词相当于形容词的性质，用在名词之前,在句中常作定语。
My name is J oh n Green.
我叫约翰·格林。
②如果名词前用了形容词性物主代词,就不能再用冠词(a，the)、指示代词(this，that，these，
those）等修饰词。
This is his desk.
这是他的书桌。
③与形容词一起修饰名词时,形容词性物主代词要放在形容词的前面。
his English books他的英语书
(2)名词性物主代词的用法
①名词性物主代词常用来避免和前面已提及的名词重复,相当于“形容词性物主代词+名
词”。
My pen is quite different from his.
我的钢笔和他的钢笔相当不同。
②名词性物主代词相当于名词,在句中可作主语、宾语、表语。
—May I use your pen?
我可以用你的钢笔吗?
—Yours works better.(主语)
你的笔比我的好用。
③在使用名词性物主代词时,必须有特定的语言环境，也就是要省略的名词。只有上文提及
了某个名词,才会知道名词性物主代词指代的事物。
It ’ s hers.
是她的。
④名词性物主代词可以用于“a/an/this/that/some/no+名词+of+名词性物主代词”句型中,这
里名词性物主代词在句中作定语也就是名词性物主代词与of连用作定语。
The bag of hers is especially attractive.
她的包特别引人注目。
3.反身代词
反身代词也称自身代词,表示主语动作的对象或表现的特征是自己本身,动作的承受者和执
行者是同一个人或物。
⑴用在动词或介词后作宾语
The old man ha s bee n teaching himself English.
这位老人一直自学英语。
⑵表示“本人，本身”，用作同位语
The students painted their classrooms themselves.
学生们自己粉刷了教室。
⑶在系动词后作表语，表示身体或精神状态
I am not quite myself these days.
我近来身体不太舒服
⑷用于某些习惯用语或固定结构中
by oneself独自，单独；独立地
4.指示代词
指示代词是指示前面的名词并代替它的词,表示“这个（些)”“那个(些)”等意思,起指示
作用。
(1)this，that，these，those的语法功能
①指示代词既可作限定词又可作代词。
指示代词用作名词中心词的修饰语时属于限定词,指示代词还可以用来代替名词,避免重复。
This girl is M a r y.（限定词）
这个女孩是玛丽。
This is M a r y.（代词）
这是玛丽。
②指示代词在句子中可充当主语、宾语、表语、定语。
This is the way to do it.( 主语 )
这事儿就该这样做。
I like this better than that.( 宾语)
我喜欢这个多于那个。
I do n ’ t say no to that.( 宾语)
我并未拒绝那个。
My point is this.(表语)
我的观点就是如此。
This room is mine.(定语）
这间房间是我的。
③指代上下文出现的名词。
The air quality in Shanghai is higher than that in Be i j in g.
上海的空气质量比北京好。
⑵so，such，same句法功能
①so意思是“如此；这样”。
用在believe,，think,，expect， suppose， guess，hope等动词后，代替一个宾语从句。否定
式用not。
—Is that To m?
那是汤姆吗？
—Yes,I think so.
是的，我想是的。
②thesame意思是“同一个/同样的人或事物”。
What eve rId i d,he tried to dot he same.
无论我做什么，他都尽量做同样的事。
③such意思是“像……一样的人或事物”。
Such is life. 这就是生活。
5.不定代词
常见的不定代词用法
⑴some，any
既可以指代或修饰不可数名词,也可以指代或修饰可数名词复数。
some 常用在肯定中；any 多用在否定、疑问句及条件句中。
Some battles you win,some battles you lose.
胜败乃兵家常事。
I do n ’ t want anymore of that heavy stuff.
我再也不想碰那种麻烦事了。
⑵many，much，few，little，afew，alittle
①many，afew，few 用来代替或修饰可数名词复数,而 much，alittle，little 用来代替或修
饰不可数名词。
There ha s n ’ t bee n much good weather recently.
最近天气不太好。
②afew和alittle含肯定意义表示有一些;few和little含否定意义,表示没有多少。
They ha d little money with them.
他们没什么钱。
I poured a little more wine into my glass.
我又往酒杯里倒了点儿葡萄酒。
⑶each,every
each 指两个或两个以上的人或物中的每一个,强调个体，而every 指三个或三个以上的人或
物中的每一个,侧重整体;each 指若干固定数目中的每一个(特指),而 every 指任何一个(泛
指)；each兼有代词和形容词特点，可作主语、同位语、定语和宾语，而every是形容词，
只能作定语。
Each student(Each of the students)ha s a dictionary.
每个学生有一本字典。
Every member ha s ash are in the profits made by the company.
每个会员都可以分享公司的盈利。
6.相互代词
相互代词就是表示相互关系的代词。它与所指代的名词或代词是一种互指关系,因此它们表
示复数意义或者二者以上。
相互代词的宾格在句中作宾语,相互代词的所有格在句中可以作定语。
Dogs bark,cocks crow,frogs c r oak to each other.（宾语）
犬吠、鸡鸣、蛙儿对唱。
They could do nothing except stand g a z in g into one another ’ s eyes.（定语）
他们除了站在那儿相互看着以外,什么办法也没有。
7.疑问代词
疑问代词指的是引出特殊疑问句的代词。常见的疑问代词有what、which、who、whom、
whose等。疑问代词在句中作主语、宾语、表语,定语等。
Whos aid that?（主语）
那是谁说的?
What would you like to do during your spare time?（宾语）
你空闲时喜欢做什么?
What are your reasons for resigning? （表语）
你辞职的原因是什么?
Whose bag is this?（定语）
这是谁的包?

grammar.title: 形容词和副词
grammar.body:
形容词
形容词是说明人或事物的属性、状态或特征的词,在句子中主要修饰名词。形容词通常置于
其修饰的名词之前,并且多数形容词具有比较等级。
1.形容词的句法功能
副词可在句子作定语、表语、补语和状语。
The company is in a difficult situation.（定语）
这家公司正处于困难的境地。
This bike is expensive.（表语）
这辆自行车很贵。
He spents even days in the wind ands now,cold and hungry.（补语）
他又冷又饿,在风雪中过了7天。
Curious,we went into the cave.（状语）
因为好奇，所以我们进入了洞里面。
2.形容词的排列顺序
限定描绘大长高,形状年龄和新旧；
颜色国籍出材料,作用类别往后靠。
副词
1.副词的句法功能
副词可在句子作状语、表语、定语和补足。
The boy is always asking his parents for money.（状语）
那个男孩老是向他父母要钱。
M a r y w as down with as light fever.（表语）
玛丽有点发烧。
The villagers there are busy getting in wheat.（定语）
那里的村民正忙着收小麦。
S t even do e s his homework carefully.（补语）
史蒂芬做功课很细心。
2.副词的位置
⑴副词作定语时，多放在所修饰的名词之后
I saw him on my way home.
在回家的路上我遇见了他。
⑵副词修饰形容词、副词时,一般放在被修饰词之前,但enough 除外
It ’ s rather difficult to tell who is right.
很难说谁是对的。
He d i d n ’ t run fast enough to catch the train.
他的奔跑速度不足以快到能够追上火车。
⑶疑问副词、连接副词、关系副词和一些修饰整个句子的副词通常都放在句子(从句)的开
头
Why wash e late?
他为什么迟到了?
⑷否定副词在句首,句子要部分倒装
Never have I felt so relaxed!
我从来没有如此放松过!

grammar.title: 动词
grammar.body:
1.及物动词
及物动词在语法意义上不完整,后面需要接宾语作为动作的接受者。
I believe that the committee will consider our suggestion.
我相信委员会将会考虑我们的建议。
2.不及物动词
不及物动词在语法意义上是完整的,不涉及动作的接受者,后面不需要跟宾语,因此也就没有
被动语态。
He arrived late this morning.
他今天早上迟到了。
3.兼作及物动词和不及物动词
She began working as a librarian afters he left school.(及物动词)
她毕业后当了图书管理员。
Shall I begin at once?(不及物动词)
我可以立刻开始吗?
4.延续性动词
延续性动词表示持续的行为或状态。
I have learned English since I came here.
自从我来到这儿就学英语了。
5.非延续性动词
非延续性动词也可以称作短暂性动词、瞬间性动词,表示短暂的(不能持续的)动作,这类动作
往往发生后立即结束。
误:She ha s died for three years.
正: She ha s bee n dead for three years.
她去世三年了。
6.连系动词
连系动词本身有词义,但不能单独作谓语,必须和表语一起构成“系表结构”,用于说明主语
的状况、性质、特征等情况。
He looks tired.
他看起来很累。
7.助动词
助动词本身没有独立的意义,不能单独作谓语,必须和实义动词或连系动词的某种形式一起
构成谓语,表示否定、疑问以及动词的时态、语态、语气、人称和数等特征。助动词在句子
中必须同主语的人称和数一致。英语中常见的助动词有be，have，do，shall,，will等。
I have to get there before six.
我必须在6点前到那儿。
8.情态动词
⑴can，could
①表示能力。
He is over ninety,buts till can read without glasses.
他已经九十多了,但不戴眼镜仍能看书。
I could lift heavy things like that when I w as young.
年轻的时候,我可以举起那样沉重的东西。
②表示许可、允许。
Could/Can you tell me how to get to the post office?
你能告诉我怎么去邮局吗?
③表示推测。
The shy girl can ’ t/could n ’ t be our monitor.
这位害差的女孩不可能当我们的班长。
④表示惊讶、迷惑等语气。
Can/Could it be true?I can ’ t believe my eyes and ears.
那可能是真的吗?我真不敢相信我的眼睛和耳朵。
⑵may，might
①表示许可、请求。
Youmay/might walk for miles in the country without meeting anyone.
在乡下你可能走好几里路也碰不见一个人。
②表示可能。
She may change her mind.I will wait for her.
她可能会改变心意,我会等她。
③表示信念和希望(may+名词+不带to的不定式)。
May God bless you!
上帝保佑你!
May you succeed!
祝你成功!
④表示推测。
表示对现在或将来动作或状态的推测。
Shemay/might be washing her clothes.
她可能正在洗衣服。
You might have told us earlier.
你早点告诉我们就好了。
⑶must
①表示义务、强迫,是说话人的主观看法。
You musts how the guard your pass when you enter this building.
要进入大楼你必须向警卫出示通行证。
②表示强烈的禁止。
You must n ’ t smoke here.
你不许在这儿抽烟。
③表示必然的结果。
All men must die.
人固有一死。
④表示“偏偏,非要”。
The car must breakdown just when I w as about to start.
我正要出发时,偏偏车坏了
⑤表示推测。
Listen!There must be a cat in the room.
听,房间里肯定有只猫。
⑷need和dare
这两个词既可以用作实义动词又可作情态动词,这里主要讲述其情态动词的用法。
①need和dare主要用于疑问句、否定句和条件句。
You need n ’ t dot his if you do n ’ t want to.
你不想干这事就别干。
He asked me if I dare got here alone.
他问我是否敢一个人去那儿。
②need表示对过去的责备。
You need n ’ t have mentioned it at the party yesterday.
昨天的聚会上你不必提那件事。
⑸shall
①表示“将来”。
I will be forty years old next year.
明年我就40岁了。
②表示承诺、警告等。
If you do n ’ t come,yous hall be punished.
如果你不来,你会受到惩罚的。
③表示决定或决心(用于第一人称)。
Is hall come if I want to.
我想来的话,我就来。
④表示应该(指按照法律、规章制度等应该做)。
The National Party Congresss hall be convene d every five years.
全国代表大会每五年举行一次。
⑹should
①表示应当、应该。
Everyone should do his duty.
人人应该尽义务。
②表示责备、批评。
You should have called me last night.
你昨晚本应该给我打电话。
③表示推测。
Everything should be ready by now.
现在一切应该都准备好了。
④表示委婉、谦逊的语气。
I should like to have a talk with you.
我想跟你谈一谈。
⑤表示说话人的特殊感情,常用于名词性从句中。
It is surprising that he should be so foolish.
他竟是那么愚笨,实在令人惊讶。
⑥用于虚拟语气。
If you should change your mind,do let me know.
万一你改变主意，一定要告诉我。
⑺oughtto
①表示应该。
You ought to visit your parents more often.
你应该经常去看你父母。
②表示责备、批评。
He ought to have come yesterday,but he d i d n ’ t.
他昨天应该来的，但他没有来。
③表示对过去、现在、将来的推测。
If he started at nine,he ought to be here by now.
要是他九点出发,现在该到这儿了。
⑻will
①表示即将发生的动作或存在的状态。
I will arrive at the cinema before six o ’ clock.
我会在六点前到达电影院。
②表示主观意志和愿望。
He ha s to dot he cooking,whether he will or not.
无论他是否愿意,他都得做饭。
③表示坚持(用于肯定句)和拒绝( 用于否定句)。
We will never talk about that subject again.
我们绝不会再谈论这个话题。
④表示主语的习惯性动作或某种倾向(通常用于第三人称）。
This window w on ’ to pen.
这扇窗户老是打不开。
⑤表示请求、拜托或劝说（用于第二人称)。
Will you pass met he book,please?
请把书递给我,好吗?
⑼would
①表示习惯。
Whatever happened,he would not mind.
无论发生什么,他都不会介意的。
②表示征求意见或提出请求。
Would you pass met he bottle?
请你递给我那个瓶子好吗?
③表示推测,意为“大概、也许'。
I think he would accept the invitation.
我想他会接受邀请的。

grammar.title: 非谓语动词
grammar.body:
1.动词不定式
动词不定式是由“to+动词原形”所构成的,它虽具有动词形式,但是已经失去了动词的功能,
可在句中充当主语、宾语、表语、定语、状语以及补语。
To be a doctor is hard.（主语）
做医生很难。
He found it hard to catch up with others.（宾语）
他觉得赶上别人很困难。
Her parents wish her to beat eacher.（补语）
她父母亲希望她当老师。
His dream is to be a doctor.（表语）
他的梦想是成为一名医生。
Who w as the first one to arrive?（定语）
谁第一个到的?
He went to see his sister yesterday.（状语）
他昨天去看他妹妹了。
2.动名词
动名词是由动词在词尾加-ing构成的,其作用相当于名词,它在句中充当主语、宾语、表语、
定语以及补语。
Reading is an art.（主语）
读书是一种艺术。
They all avoided mentioning that name.（宾语）
他们全都避免提及那个名字。
Seeing is be lie v in g.（表语）
眼见为实。
The girl standing there is my friend.（定语）
站着的那个女孩是我的朋友。
He suggests the government taking necessary measures to reduce the cost.（补语）
他建议政府应该采取必要的措施来降低成本。
3.现在分词
现在分词由动词-ing形式构成,在其前面添加否定词not可构成否定式。
现在分词在句中相当于形容词、副词,在句中可以作表语、定语、补语、状语。
His work is disappointing.（表语）
他的工作令人失望。
What disappointing news!（定语）
多么令人失望的消息。
He soon ha d them all laughing.（补语）
他很快逗得大家都笑了。
Working hard,you will succeed.（状语)
如果努力工作，你就可以成功。
4.过去分词
过去分词保留着动词的许多特征,所以在句中有自己的状语和逻辑主语，及物动词的过去分
词既可以表示被动,又可以表示完成,不及物动词的过去分词只可以表示完成,不可以表示被
动。
The watered flowers look quite beautiful in thes un.（定语）
浇过水的花在太阳底下看起来格外漂亮。
She felt very tired.（表语）
她感到很累。
I saw the river pollute d when I came back two years later.（补语）
两年后我回到那里,发现那条河已经被污染了。
Encourage d by the teacher,the girl w as very happy.(状语)
由于被老师鼓励,这个女孩儿非常高兴。

grammar.title: 名词性从句
grammar.body:
1.主语从句
主语从句是在复合句中作主语的名词性从句,通常放在主句谓语动词之前,而主语从句本身
放在句子末尾,其时态不受主句时态的影响和限制。主语从句的引导词有从属连词 that，
whether，if；连接代词what，who，whose，whatever，whoever；连接副词when，how，why，
where等。
Thats he w as c hose n made a tremendous stir in her village.
她被挑选上,这在她村子里引起很大轰动。
What is done can not bed one.
覆水难收。
When the conference it be he l d ha s not bee n decide d.
会议什么时候召开还没有决定。
2.宾语从句
在复合句中用作动词宾语或介词宾语的从句叫作宾语从句。宾语从句可分为三类:动词后的
宾语从句、介词后的宾语从句和形容词后的宾语从句。引导宾语从句的引导词主要有:连接
词that，whether，if 等；连接代词what, who，whose，whatever，whichever，whoever 等;
连接副词when，where，how，why等。
His mothers aid thatS a u l Grant w as a music critic.
他母亲说索尔·格兰特是位音乐评论家。
She doubted if/whether he could succeed.
她怀疑他是否能成功。
I do n ’ t like it when you look at me like that!
我不喜欢你那样看着我！
3.表语从句
在句子中作表语的从句称为表语从句。引导表语从句的引导词主要有:从属连词 that，
whether，because，asif/as though;连接代词 who，whom，whose，which，what，whoever，
whom ever,whichever，whatever等；连接副词when，where，why，how等。
The trouble is that we are short of money.
困难是我们资金短缺。
The problem is who is fit forth is job.
问题是谁适合这份工作。
The question is how he d i d it.
问题是他是如何做此事的。
4.同位语从句
同位语从句就是在复合句中作名词的同位语的名词性从句，起对其前面的抽象名词进行解释
说明的作用,同位语与被它限定的词的格式要一致,并常常紧挨在一起。引导同位语从句的引
导词有从属连词that，whether：连接代词what，who，which；连接副词how，when，where
等。
There is doubt whether he will come.
他是否来值得怀疑。
The question who will take his place is still not clear.
谁将取代他的位置暂时还不清楚。
My question how Is hall get in touch with him ha s not bee n answered.
我如何与他取得联系的问题尚未得到答复。

grammar.title: 定语从句
grammar.body:
1.定语从句引导词的选用
观察定语从句缺少何种成分(主语、宾语、定语、状语),若缺主语、宾语、定语用关系代词,
缺状语用关系副词。一般从句谓语若为及物动词,后面没有宾语就必须用关系代词;从句谓语
若为不及物动词,则要用关系副词。
Is till remember the day which/that we spent together.（从句缺宾语，用关系代词）
我还记得我们一起度过的那一天。
Is till remember the day when we stayed together.(从句缺状语用关系副词)
我还记得那一天我们待在一起。
口诀：
that可作主、宾用,指人指物它能行；
which用来指物用,主语宾语它都能；
who和whom指人用，作主作宾要分清；
从句常和副词连，why，where还有when；
前有介词换 which，从句意思仍以前；
从句如缺主宾表,仍须关系代词连。
2.限制性定语从句和非限制性定语从句的区别
⑴句法功能、表现形式不同
限制性定语从句不可缺少先行词,去掉后主句意思往往不明确,它与主句之间通常不用逗号
分开；非限制性定语从句是对先行词的附加说明,去掉后不会影响主句的意思。
She ha s found the necklace which/thats he lost two weeks ago.
她找到了两周前丢的项链。(其他时间丢的项链是否找到,没说)
She ha s found the necklace,whichs he lost two weeks ago.
她已经找到那条项链,那条项链是两周前丢的。(只有一条项链)
⑵先行词不同
限制性定语从句的先行词往往是某一个词,但非限制性定语从句的先行词可以是一个词,也
可以是句子的一部分,甚至是整个主句。
此时非限制性定语从句一般由 which 或 as 引导,as 引导非限制性定语从句常用在 as is
said/known/expected/mentioned/reported/announce d等结构中。
He ha s passed the college entrance examination,which makes his parents quite happy.
他已经通过了高考,这使他的父母很高兴。
As is known to everybody,the moon travels round the earth once every month.
众所周知，月亮每月绕地球运行一次。

grammar.title: 状语从句
grammar.body:
1.时间状语从句
when当……时 until直到
while当……时 instantly一……就……
as当……的时候 directly一……就……
before在……之前 hardly...when 一……就……
since自从 as soon as一……就……
till直到 the moment一……就……
every time每次 immediately一……就……
after在……之后 no sooner...than一……就……
ever since自从 scarcely...when一……就……
While J oh n w as watching TV,his wife w as cooking.
当约翰看电视时,他的妻子正在做饭。
I d i d n ’ t realize how special my mother w as until I became an adult.
直到我长大成人,我才意识到我母亲有多特别。
2.地点状语从句
地点状语从句主要由where引导,意为“在……的地方”,有时也可由wherever(无论在……
地方)和everywhere(每一个……的地方)引导。
You should have put the book where you found it.
你本应该把书放回原来的地方。
Wherever you go,you should work hard.
无论去哪里,你都应该努力工作。
3.原因状语从句
原因状语从句表示主句谓语行为的原因，常常由because，as，since，nowthat，for等从属
连词引导。
I d i d n ’ t go to school yesterday because I w as ill.
我昨天没去上学,因为我生病了。
As you are in poor health,you should not stay up late.
既然你身体不好，你就不该熬夜。
4.条件状语从句
条件状语从句表示主句谓语行为发生的条件,通常由 unless, suppose, provided (that) , on
condition that,as(so)longas,in等从属连词引导。
If you ask him,he will help you.
如果你请求他,他会帮助你。
Unless the rains tops,we shall not go out for play.
除非雨停，否则我们不出去玩。
5.目的状语从句
引导目的状语从句的连词有：in order that，sothat，incase，lest，for fear that等。lest,forfear
that后的目的状语从句一般要用“(should+)动词原形”的形式；incase后的目的状语从句
多用虚拟语气,但也可用陈述语气。
Hear range d everything so that we could get there at one o ’ clock.
他安排好了一切,以便我们能在一点钟到达那里。
We used the computer in order that we could save time.
我们使用计算机是为了节省时间。
6.结果状语从句
引导结果状语从句的从属连词主要有sothat，so...that，such...that等。
I went to the lecture early so that I got a goods eat.
我去听讲座去得很早，所以找了个好座位。
It ’ s so difficult a question that none of us can answer it.
那是一个很难的问题,我们没有一个人能回答。
7.让步状语从句
让步状语从句表示在某种相反的条件下主句、谓语行为仍然发生,通常由 though，although，
even if, even though 等从属连词，no matter+wh-疑问词,带 ever 的 wh-疑问词，whether...or
结构等引导。放在主句之前、之中或之后皆可。
I ’ l l get there even if/even though I have to walk all the way.
即使得一路走着,我也要走到那里。
Child as he is,he knows a lot.
尽管他只是个孩子,他懂得很多。
8.方式状语从句
方式状语从句通常由 as(像,如同)，justas(正如)，asif/though(好像)引导。asif/as though 从
句若与事实相反,则用虚拟语气,否则用陈述语气。
When in R o me,do as the Romans do.
入乡随俗。
It looks as if it ’ s going to rain.
看起来似乎要下雨。
9.比较状语从句
比较状语从句表示行为或事物之间的比较,通常由as...as，than，notso(as)...as等从属连词
引导。
The boys t u died as hard as the girl.
男孩和女孩一样学习努力。
Today is more bright and beautiful than it w as yesterday
今天天气比昨天更加晴朗美好。

grammar.title: 被动语态
grammar.body:
被动语态由“助动词be+及物动词的过去分词”构成。被动语态的时态变化只改变be的形
式,过去分词部分不变。疑问式和否定式的变化也是如此。
1.被动语态的用法
(1)用于不知道或没有必要指出谁是动作的执行者时
A class meeting will be he l d next Monday.
班会将在下周一举行。
(2)当侧重强调动作的承受者时,要用被动语态这种情况下,动作的执行者由by引导,置于谓
语动词之后,不需要时可以省略
Food is needed bye very living thing.
食物是每个生物的必需品。
(3)当动作的执行者不是人时,多用被动语态
The window w as blow n by wind.
窗户被风吹开了。
(4)为了使语气婉转,避免提及自己或对方
The construction of the new lab must be complete d by the end of next month.
新实验室的建设必须在下月底前完成。
(5)表示客观的说明常用“Itis+过去分词+that”句型
It is said that L u c y ha s gone abroad.
据说露西已经出国了。
(6)其他常见的“Itis+过去分词+that”句型
It is reported that five people died in the traffic accident.
据报道,有5人死于那起交通事故。
2.主动形式表被动意义
(1)连系动词的主动形式表被动意义
像taste，feel，smell，sound，look，stay等连系动词要用主动形式表示被动意义。
The flower smells sweet.
这花闻起来很香。
The desk feels smooth.
桌子摸起来很光滑。
(2)某些不及物动词的主动形式表被动意义
像sell，wear，wash，read，open，shut等(既可作不及物动词又可作及物动词),作不及物动
词时,跟easily，well，nicely，smoothly等连用,强调谓语动词给主语带来的某种结果,此时
要用主动形式表示被动意义。
The dress sells well.
这种衣服畅销。
This kind of cloth washes easily.
这种布耐洗。
(3)有少数动词的主动形式表被动意义
bind，cook，do，owe，print的进行时有时有被动意义,在这种用法中,句子的主语都应该是
指物的。
The magazine is printing.
这本杂志正在印刷。
Theme at is cooking.
肉正在煮。
(4)动名词的主动形式表被动意义
在need/want/require/deserve doing句型中,动名词（doing)相当于动词不定式的被动式(tobe
done),在意思上没有多大差别。
The garden needs watering.
=The garden needs to be watered.
花园需要浇水。
The problem requires studying with great care.
=The problem requires to best u died with great care.
这个问题需要仔细研究。
(5)动词不定式的主动形式表被动意义有些动词不定式无论用主动形式还是被动形式,动词
不定式和主语的关系都是被动的
Nobody w as to blame(to be blame d)fort he accident.
这个事故,谁也不能责怪。
Those cars are to rent(to be rented).
那些汽车要出租。

tips.title: 名词
tips.body:
名词是表示人、事物、地点或抽象概念的词。
⑴名词的语法功能
名词在句中主要作主语、宾语、表语、状语、定语、补语和同位语。
Thisbookisveryuseful.（主语）
这本书非常有用。
Hefinishedhistaskontime.（宾语）
他按时完成了任务。
Mybrotherisaworker.（表语）
我弟弟是一名工人。
Themeetinglastedtwohours.（状语）
这场会议持续了两个小时。
Hismotherandfatherarebothcollegeteachers.（定语）
他的父母都是大学教师。
Theymadethegirldirectorofthecompany.（补语）
他们任命这个女孩为公司的董事长。
Westudentsshouldstudyhard.（同位语）
我们学生应该努力学习。
⑵名词的数
规则可数名词单数变复数变化口诀：
名词单数变复数，直接加-s占多数;
s,x,ch,sh 来结尾,直接加上-es;
辅音+y在词尾,把y变i加-es;
词尾是f 或是fe,加-es 之前先变v;
词尾字母若是o,无生命的加-s。
名词所有格
名词所有格,表物是“谁的”;
若为生命词,加“s”即可行;
词尾有s,仅把撇号择;并列名词后,各自和共有;
前者分别加，后者最后加;
若为无命词，of 所有格;
前后须倒置,此是硬规则。

tips.title: 非谓语动词
tips.body:
⑴动词不定式
动词不定式是由“to+动词原形”所构成的,它虽具有动词形式,但是已经失去了动词的功能,
可在句中充当主语、宾语、表语、定语、状语以及补语。
Tobeadoctorishard.（主语）
做医生很难。
Hefoundithardtocatchupwithothers.（宾语）
他觉得赶上别人很困难。
Herparentswishhertobeateacher.（补语）
她父母亲希望她当老师。
Hisdreamistobeadoctor.（表语）
他的梦想是成为一名医生。
Whowasthefirstonetoarrive?（定语）
谁第一个到的?
Hewenttoseehissisteryesterday.（状语）
他昨天去看他妹妹了。
⑵动名词
动名词是由动词在词尾加-ing构成的,其作用相当于名词,它在句中充当主语、宾语、表语、
定语以及补语。
Readingisanart.（主语）
读书是一种艺术。
Theyallavoidedmentioningthatname.（宾语）
他们全都避免提及那个名字。
Seeingisbelieving.（表语）
眼见为实。
Thegirlstandingthereismyfriend.（定语）
站着的那个女孩是我的朋友。
Hesuggeststhegovernmenttakingnecessarymeasurestoreducethecost.（补语）
他建议政府应该采取必要的措施来降低成本。
⑶现在分词
现在分词由动词-ing形式构成,在其前面添加否定词not可构成否定式。
现在分词在句中相当于形容词、副词,在句中可以作表语、定语、补语、状语。
Hisworkisdisappointing.（表语）
他的工作令人失望。
Whatdisappointingnews!（定语）
多么令人失望的消息。
Hesoonhadthemalllaughing.（补语）
他很快逗得大家都笑了。
Workinghard,youwillsucceed.（状语)
如果努力工作，你就可以成功。
⑷过去分词
过去分词保留着动词的许多特征,所以在句中有自己的状语和逻辑主语，及物动词的过去分
词既可以表示被动,又可以表示完成,不及物动词的过去分词只可以表示完成,不可以表示被
动。
Thewateredflowerslookquitebeautifulinthesun.（定语）
浇过水的花在太阳底下看起来格外漂亮。
Shefeltverytired.（表语）
她感到很累。
IsawtheriverpollutedwhenIcamebacktwoyearslater.（补语）
两年后我回到那里,发现那条河已经被污染了。
Encouragedbytheteacher,thegirlwasveryhappy.(状语)
由于被老师鼓励,这个女孩儿非常高兴。

tips.title: 形容词
tips.body:
形容词是说明人或事物的属性、状态或特征的词,在句子中主要修饰名词。形容词通常置于
其修饰的名词之前,并且多数形容词具有比较等级。
⑴形容词的句法功能
副词可在句子作定语、表语、补语和状语。
Thecompanyisinadifficultsituation.（定语）
这家公司正处于困难的境地。
Thisbikeisexpensive.（表语）
这辆自行车很贵。
Hespentsevendaysinthewindandsnow,coldandhungry.（补语）
他又冷又饿,在风雪中过了7天。
Curious,wewentintothecave.（状语）
因为好奇，所以我们进入了洞里面。
⑵形容词的排列顺序
限定描绘大长高,形状年龄和新旧；
颜色国籍出材料,作用类别往后靠。

tips.title: 副词
tips.body:
⑴副词的句法功能
副词可在句子作状语、表语、定语和补足。
Theboyisalwaysaskinghisparentsformoney.（状语）
那个男孩老是向他父母要钱。
Marywasdownwithaslightfever.（表语）
玛丽有点发烧。
Thevillagerstherearebusygettinginwheat.（定语）
那里的村民正忙着收小麦。
Stevendoeshishomeworkcarefully.（补语）
史蒂芬做功课很细心。
⑵副词的位置
①副词作定语时，多放在所修饰的名词之后
Isawhimonmywayhome.
在回家的路上我遇见了他。
②副词修饰形容词、副词时,一般放在被修饰词之前,但enough 除外
It’sratherdifficulttotellwhoisright.
很难说谁是对的。
Hedidn’trunfastenoughtocatchthetrain.
他的奔跑速度不足以快到能够追上火车。
③疑问副词、连接副词、关系副词和一些修饰整个句子的副词通常都放在句子(从句)的开
头
Whywashelate?
他为什么迟到了?
④否定副词在句首,句子要部分倒装
NeverhaveIfeltsorelaxed!
我从来没有如此放松过!

tips.title: 动词
tips.body:
⑴及物动词
及物动词在语法意义上不完整,后面需要接宾语作为动作的接受者。
Ibelievethatthecommitteewillconsideroursuggestion.
我相信委员会将会考虑我们的建议。
⑵不及物动词
不及物动词在语法意义上是完整的,不涉及动作的接受者,后面不需要跟宾语,因此也就没有
被动语态。
Hearrivedlatethismorning.
他今天早上迟到了。
⑶兼作及物动词和不及物动词
Shebeganworkingasalibrarianaftersheleftschool.(及物动词)
她毕业后当了图书管理员。
ShallIbeginatonce?(不及物动词)
我可以立刻开始吗?
⑷延续性动词
延续性动词表示持续的行为或状态。
IhavelearnedEnglishsinceIcamehere.
自从我来到这儿就学英语了。
⑸非延续性动词
非延续性动词也可以称作短暂性动词、瞬间性动词,表示短暂的(不能持续的)动作,这类动作
往往发生后立即结束。
误:Shehasdiedforthreeyears.
正: Shehasbeendeadforthreeyears.
她去世三年了。
⑹连系动词
连系动词本身有词义,但不能单独作谓语,必须和表语一起构成“系表结构”,用于说明主语
的状况、性质、特征等情况。
Helookstired.
他看起来很累。
⑺助动词
助动词本身没有独立的意义,不能单独作谓语,必须和实义动词或连系动词的某种形式一起
构成谓语,表示否定、疑问以及动词的时态、语态、语气、人称和数等特征。助动词在句子
中必须同主语的人称和数一致。英语中常见的助动词有be，have，do，shall,，will等。
Ihavetogettherebeforesix.
我必须在6点前到那儿。
常考句法

tips.title: 主语从句
tips.body:
主语从句是在复合句中作主语的名词性从句,通常放在主句谓语动词之前,而主语从句本身
放在句子末尾,其时态不受主句时态的影响和限制。主语从句的引导词有从属连词 that，
whether，if；连接代词what，who，whose，whatever，whoever；连接副词when，how，why，
where等。
Thatshewaschosenmadeatremendousstirinhervillage.
她被挑选上,这在她村子里引起很大轰动。
Whatisdonecannotbedone.
覆水难收。
Whentheconferenceitbeheldhasnotbeendecided.
会议什么时候召开还没有决定。

tips.title: 宾语从句
tips.body:
在复合句中用作动词宾语或介词宾语的从句叫作宾语从句。宾语从句可分为三类:动词后的
宾语从句、介词后的宾语从句和形容词后的宾语从句。引导宾语从句的引导词主要有:连接
词that，whether，if 等；连接代词what, who，whose，whatever，whichever，whoever 等;
连接副词when，where，how，why等。
HismothersaidthatSaulGrantwasamusiccritic.
他母亲说索尔·格兰特是位音乐评论家。
Shedoubtedif/whetherhecouldsucceed.
她怀疑他是否能成功。
Idon’tlikeitwhenyoulookatmelikethat!
我不喜欢你那样看着我！

tips.title: 表语从句
tips.body:
在句子中作表语的从句称为表语从句。引导表语从句的引导词主要有:从属连词 that，
whether，because，asif/asthough;连接代词 who，whom，whose，which，what，whoever，
whomever,whichever，whatever等；连接副词when，where，why，how等。
Thetroubleisthatweareshortofmoney.
困难是我们资金短缺。
Theproblemiswhoisfitforthisjob.
问题是谁适合这份工作。
Thequestionishowhedidit.
问题是他是如何做此事的。

tips.title: 同位语从句
tips.body:
同位语从句就是在复合句中作名词的同位语的名词性从句，起对其前面的抽象名词进行解释
说明的作用,同位语与被它限定的词的格式要一致,并常常紧挨在一起。引导同位语从句的引
导词有从属连词that，whether：连接代词what，who，which；连接副词how，when，where
等。
Thereisdoubtwhetherhewillcome.
他是否来值得怀疑。
Thequestionwhowilltakehisplaceisstillnotclear.
谁将取代他的位置暂时还不清楚。
MyquestionhowIshallgetintouchwithhimhasnotbeenanswered.
我如何与他取得联系的问题尚未得到答复。

tips.title: 定语从句
tips.body:
⑴定语从句引导词的选用
观察定语从句缺少何种成分(主语、宾语、定语、状语),若缺主语、宾语、定语用关系代词,
缺状语用关系副词。一般从句谓语若为及物动词,后面没有宾语就必须用关系代词;从句谓语
若为不及物动词,则要用关系副词。
Istillrememberthedaywhich/thatwespenttogether.（从句缺宾语，用关系代词）
我还记得我们一起度过的那一天。
Istillrememberthedaywhenwestayedtogether.(从句缺状语用关系副词)
我还记得那一天我们待在一起。
口诀：
that可作主、宾用,指人指物它能行；
which用来指物用,主语宾语它都能；
who和whom指人用，作主作宾要分清；
从句常和副词连，why，where还有when；
前有介词换 which，从句意思仍以前；
从句如缺主宾表,仍须关系代词连。
⑵限制性定语从句和非限制性定语从句的区别
①句法功能、表现形式不同
限制性定语从句不可缺少先行词,去掉后主句意思往往不明确,它与主句之间通常不用逗号
分开；非限制性定语从句是对先行词的附加说明,去掉后不会影响主句的意思。
Shehasfoundthenecklacewhich/thatshelosttwoweeksago.
她找到了两周前丢的项链。(其他时间丢的项链是否找到,没说)
Shehasfoundthenecklace,whichshelosttwoweeksago.
她已经找到那条项链,那条项链是两周前丢的。(只有一条项链)
②先行词不同
限制性定语从句的先行词往往是某一个词,但非限制性定语从句的先行词可以是一个词,也
可以是句子的一部分,甚至是整个主句。
此时非限制性定语从句一般由 which 或 as 引导,as 引导非限制性定语从句常用在 as is
said/known/expected/mentioned/reported/announced等结构中。
Hehaspassedthecollegeentranceexamination,whichmakeshisparentsquitehappy.
他已经通过了高考,这使他的父母很高兴。
Asisknowntoeverybody,themoontravelsroundtheearthonceeverymonth.
众所周知，月亮每月绕地球运行一次。

tips.body:

tips.title: 地点状语从句
tips.body:
地点状语从句主要由where引导,意为“在……的地方”,有时也可由wherever(无论在……
地方)和everywhere(每一个……的地方)引导。
Youshouldhaveputthebookwhereyoufoundit.
你本应该把书放回原来的地方。
Whereveryougo,youshouldworkhard.
无论去哪里,你都应该努力工作。

tips.title: 原因状语从句
tips.body:
原因状语从句表示主句谓语行为的原因，常常由because，as，since，nowthat，for等从属
连词引导。
Ididn’tgotoschoolyesterdaybecauseIwasill.
我昨天没去上学,因为我生病了。
Asyouareinpoorhealth,youshouldnotstayuplate.
既然你身体不好，你就不该熬夜。

tips.title: 条件状语从句
tips.body:
条件状语从句表示主句谓语行为发生的条件,通常由 unless, suppose, provided (that) , on
conditionthat,as(so)longas,in等从属连词引导。
Ifyouaskhim,hewillhelpyou.
如果你请求他,他会帮助你。
Unlesstherainstops,weshallnotgooutforplay.
除非雨停，否则我们不出去玩。

tips.title: 目的状语从句
tips.body:
引导目的状语从句的连词有：inorderthat，sothat，incase，lest，forfearthat等。lest,forfear
that后的目的状语从句一般要用“(should+)动词原形”的形式；incase后的目的状语从句
多用虚拟语气,但也可用陈述语气。
Hearrangedeverythingsothatwecouldgetthereatoneo’clock.
他安排好了一切,以便我们能在一点钟到达那里。
Weusedthecomputerinorderthatwecouldsavetime.
我们使用计算机是为了节省时间。

tips.title: 结果状语从句
tips.body:
引导结果状语从句的从属连词主要有sothat，so...that，such...that等。
IwenttothelectureearlysothatIgotagoodseat.
我去听讲座去得很早，所以找了个好座位。
It’ssodifficultaquestionthatnoneofuscananswerit.

tips.title: 重复译法
tips.body:
英译汉时往往将英文中省略的词，根据上下文语义在译文中重复翻译出来，以实现汉语译文
的通顺和意义准确。
HegavemeabookwhichIkepttothisday.
他曾经送给我一本书。这本书我一直保存至今。
Theywerestartingfromscratch,andneededmen,gunsandtraining.
他们从零开始,需要人员,需要枪支,需要训练。

tips.title: 正译法
tips.body:
所谓正译，是指把句子按照与英语相同的语序或表达方式译成汉语。
NosoonerhadIenteredtheroomthanitrained.
我一进屋，外面就下雨了。
Youcan’tbetoocarefulwithyourexperiment.

tips.title: 反译法
tips.body:
所谓反译，则是指把句子按照与英语相反的语序或表达方式译成汉语。
Doyouknowwhysheisalwaystryingtoavoidyou?
你知道她为什么老是不想见到你？
Wemustneverstoptakinganoptimisticviewoflife.
我们要永远对生活抱乐观态度。

tips.title: 分译法
tips.body:
把原文中的一个单词译成句子，使原文的一个句子分译成两个或两个以上的句子。
They,notsurprisingly,didnotrespondatall.
他们根本不回答，这是不足为怪的。
Oneproblemintryingtodiscussmyreportingisitssheervolume.
我的报告篇幅特长，要对它进行讨论，这就成了一个问题。

tips.title: 合译法
tips.body:
合译法是把若干个短句合并成一个长句，多用于定语从句的翻译，即把定语从句与主句
合译成一句。
Pollution is a pressing problem which we must deal with.
污染是我们必须解决的一个迫切问题。
Hewasjealousandenviousofhisbrother.Heresentedthathisyoungerbrotherwassosuccessful.
他嫉妒他弟弟，痛恨弟弟取得了这么大的成功。

tips.title: 被动语态译法
tips.body:
通常翻译成汉语的主动句，用“加以”,“经过”,“用……来”等词来体现原文中的被动含
义，或将英语原文中的主语翻译为宾语,同时增补泛指性的词语“人们,大家等”作主语。
Otherquestionswillbediscussedbriefly.
其它问题将简单地加以讨论。
It is generally accepted that the experiences of the child in his first years largely determine his
characterandlaterpersonality.
人们普遍认为，孩子们的早年经历在很大程度上决定了他们的性格及其未来的人品。

tips.title: 增译法
tips.body:
一种是为了为了使译文符合目标语读者的语言习惯，需要增补一些词，如修饰词、主语、表
达时态的词等；另一种是对原文文化信息的增译。
Flowersbloomallovertheyard.
朵朵鲜花满院盛开。
Whatdelayedtheoperationwasthepatient’svomitingblood.
手术之所以推迟，是由于病人在吐血。

tips.title: 省译法
tips.body:
这是与增译法相对应的一种翻译方法，即删去不符合目标语思维习惯、语言习惯和表达方式
的词，以避免译文累赘。
YouwillbestayinginthishotelduringyourvisitinBeijing.
你在北京访问期间就住在这家饭店里。
Smokingisprohibitedinpublicplaces.公共场合禁止吸烟。

tips.title: 转换法
tips.body:
在词性方面，把名词转换为代词、形容词、动词；把动词转换成名词、形容词、副词、介词；
把形容词转换成副词和短语；
在句子成分方面，把主语变成状语、定语、宾语、表语；把谓语变成主语、定语、表语；把
定语变成状语、主语；把宾语变成主语。
在句型方面，把并列句变成复合句，把复合句变成并列句，把状语从句变成定语从句。在语
态方面，可以把主动语态变为被动语态。
